content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To restrain a dog, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Locate the heavy-duty training harness (5 minutes)
Step 2. Unbuckle the side release latches (30 seconds)
Step 3. Adjust the chest plate width (2 minutes)
Step 4. Loop the primary lead through the handle (1 minute)
Step 5. Clear a workspace in the mudroom (10 minutes)
Step 6. Check the integrity of the metal D-rings (2 minutes)
Step 7. Calibrate the tension on the retractable line (3 minutes)
Step 8. Retrieve a bag of high-value liver treats (4 minutes)
Step 9. Apply a calming pheromone spray to the collar (5 minutes)
Step 10. Position the dog's front paws over the straps (20 seconds)
Step 11. Inspect the muzzle for any debris (1 minute)
Step 12. Call the dog over with a firm command (45 seconds)
Step 13. Secure the secondary safety tether (1 minute)
Step 14. Tighten the shoulder straps for a snug fit (2 minutes)
Step 15. Lock the main buckle mechanism (10 seconds)
Step 16. Fit the soft mesh muzzle over the snout (1 minute)
Step 17. Verify that the dog can still pant comfortably (2 minutes)
Step 18. Attach the identification tags to the harness (3 minutes)
Step 19. Ensure the belly strap is not pinching skin (1 minute)
Step 20. Reward the dog with a treat for staying still (30 seconds)
Step 21. Check the leash attachment point (15 seconds)
Step 22. Shorten the leash to a control length (30 seconds)
Step 23. Thread the chest strap through the loop (1 minute)
Step 24. Connect the carabiner to the harness (20 seconds)
Step 25. Prepare the head halter (3 minutes)
Step 26. Untangle the multi-way lead (2 minutes)
Step 27. Check the dog's respiration rate (1 minute)
Step 28. Fasten the Velcro security tabs (45 seconds)
Step 29. Offer a small sip of water (1 minute)
Step 30. Guide the dog to a sitting position (30 seconds)
Step 31. Slide the neck adjustment slide (1 minute)
Step 32. Double-check the girth measurement (1 minute)
Step 33. Lay the harness flat on the floor (2 minutes)
Step 34. Test the quick-release function (1 minute)
Step 35. Wipe down the dog's paws (3 minutes)
Step 36. Open the treat pouch for easy access (30 seconds)
Step 37. Soften the muzzle straps with leather oil (15 minutes)
Step 38. Check the tension of the neck strap (45 seconds)
Step 39. Confirm the dog is centered in the harness (30 seconds)
Step 40. Grab the spare backup leash (1 minute)
Step 41. Adjust the under-arm padding (2 minutes)
Step 42. Tighten the slip-lead stopper (15 seconds)
Step 43. Clean the dog's ears to prevent irritation (5 minutes)
Step 44. Loop the head halter behind the ears (2 minutes)
Step 45. Attach the safety clip to the collar (10 seconds)
Step 46. Check the floor for slipping hazards (2 minutes)
Step 47. Refresh the scent on the calming bandana (4 minutes)
Step 48. Put on your own handling gloves (1 minute)
Step 49. Secure the dog's focus with a "look" command (1 minute)
Step 50. Shake the treat bag to get attention (10 seconds)
Step 51. Command the dog to "stay" (2 minutes)
Step 52. Check the dog's temperament (5 minutes)
Step 53. Set the brake on the retractable leash (10 seconds)
Step 54. Inspect the stitching on the lead (3 minutes)
Step 55. Retrieve the slip-lead from the hook (1 minute)
Step 56. Fit the girth strap around the ribcage (1 minute)
Step 57. Position the dog against a wall for stability (1 minute)
Step 58. Clear any fur away from the buckles (2 minutes)
Step 59. Give a final verbal praise (10 seconds)
Step 60. Check the muzzle's nose padding (1 minute)
Step 61. Engage the locking pin on the lead (15 seconds)
Step 62. Find the grooming table or platform (5 minutes)
Step 63. Locate the heavy-duty slip-lead (2 minutes)
Step 64. Check the swivel bolt on the leash (1 minute)
Step 65. Wrap your hand securely in the leash loop (15 seconds)
Step 66. Adjust the martingale loop (1 minute)
Step 67. Brush out any tangles near the harness area (5 minutes)
Step 68. Sanitize your hands (30 seconds)
Step 69. Pull the harness up the dog's legs (30 seconds)
Step 70. Adjust the height of the grooming arm (2 minutes)
Step 71. Ensure the dog is standing squarely (30 seconds)
Step 72. Gather all restraint equipment in one spot (5 minutes)
Step 73. Secure the dog's head with the halter (1 minute)
Step 74. Put the dog's favorite toy nearby (2 minutes)
Step 75. Inspect the halter for wear and tear (2 minutes)
Step 76. Click the final plastic buckle (5 seconds)
Step 77. Check the expiration of the treats (1 minute)
Step 78. Ensure the dog is calm and breathing normally (2 minutes)
Step 79. Lead the dog to the designated restraint area (1 minute)
Step 80. Apply a "wait" command (1 minute)
Step 81. Check for any twisted straps (1 minute)
Step 82. Put on a waist-belt for hands-free backup (3 minutes)
Step 83. Confirm the dog cannot back out of the harness (1 minute)
Step 84. Place the snout into the muzzle basket (20 seconds)
Step 85. Check the fit with the two-finger rule (15 seconds)
Step 86. Calm the dog with gentle strokes (3 minutes)
Step 87. Inspect the leash clip spring (1 minute)
Step 88. Hold the dog's collar for steadying (30 seconds)
Step 89. Tighten the belly cinch (45 seconds)
Step 90. Give a final "settle" command (2 minutes)
